responsibility: Adds the VFP scheduling model for Cortex-R4F on top of the integer Cortex-R4 pipeline. It defines extra floating-point issue resources, reservations, and bypasses for scalar single- and double-precision VFP moves, arithmetic, multiply-accumulate, divide/sqrt, conversions, loads/stores, and core↔VFP register transfers, capturing the dual-issue constraints specific to the R4F floating-point unit.
